martha.name: Martha
martha.comment: Martha, it's a great day for a swim, especially between 12:00–14:00 when the wind is calm and the temperature is just right. Not ideal for running, but who needs that when you can enjoy the water at 24°C? Maybe surprise Britt with a swim when they get home from their shift.

britt.name: Britt
britt.comment: Britt, it's a swimming kind of day, 24°C and calm winds make 12:00–14:00 the perfect time to hit the water. Not great for running, but who needs that when you can enjoy a relaxed swim? Maybe surprise Martha with a swim when she gets home from work, or just save it for a chill afternoon to yourselves.
